recipes.name: Creamy Gnocchi Soup
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. When hot, add the garlic, celery, onion, and carrot. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes, until golden.
Add the flour and cook for 2 minutes, stirring throughout to toast.
Add the bouillon cubes, water, cream, nutritional yeast, spice mix, and miso. Cook at a gentle simmer, partially covered, for 10 minutes.
When the veggies have cooked to your liking, add the gnocchi, spinach, and green peas. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, or until the gnocchi and peas are cooked.
Serve in bowls, add some fresh lemon juice, garnish as desired, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † For us, 2 celery ribs weighed 100 g. † For us, 1 carrot weighed 100 g. † White miso, also called "Shiro Miso," is fermented for less time than red miso, which gives it a milder, sweeter flavour. If substituting red miso, use a smaller amount and adjust to taste, as red miso is saltier and stronger.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. Freeze for up to 2 months.
